description: A home should provide stability, not constant anxiety about whether the next property tax bill or rent increase will make it unaffordable. For many families and seniors in our community, the challenge isn’t just finding housing—it’s being able to afford the home they already have.I believe we need to reduce the burden of property taxes, protect affordable manufactured housing, and encourage more housing options that meet the needs of Maine families today.My Plan to Make Housing More Affordable:
paid_for_by: Authorized by Trevor Doiron for Maine House bottom of page
title: Make Housing More Affordable
